intent.problem: Turn a written lab procedure into an inspectable simulated run.
intent.target_users: Lab automation developers, educators and researchers.

safety.reason: Chatterbox simulation only. Model proposals cannot select hardware backends or execute code.

product.benefit: Watch a procedure run and inspect why it adjusted or stopped.
product.how_it_works: Reads Markdown, plans typed liquid-handling steps, observes a PyLabRobot simulation and records bounded adaptations.
product.input: Markdown goal, explicit starting inventory, numbered instructions and final well-volume goals.
product.output: Live PyLabRobot visualizer, saved deck replay, step evidence and a review report.
product.customizable_for: Simulated liquid transfers, mixing, waits and volume checks.
